correctness.rationale: The general identity is equivalent, in every field, to P(a+u)=av+L(u), L^2=0, 2L(v)=0. Conjugation is precisely the GL(V) action on (L,v), whose centralizer orbits coincide with four flag positions. Gaussian-binomial choices give exact counts, and q-product bounds give the generic-index probability. A standalone checker directly enumerates all maps and all automorphism orbits in the reported small prime-field cases; these are checks, not substitutes for infinite proof.
